title: Round bread serving basket with removable liner
text: Round bread serving basket with removable liner. The basket is wicker - the liner is thin, but pretty.  They are bit bigger than I thought, but they'll work nicely.  I make round rustic bread balls and the baskets are bigger than the bread balls but I think I'll 2 balls, sliced in each one.  I also made a additional purchase of some bread towels too - which I think was a good idea since the pretty liners are so thin.  All in all, a nice purchase.  Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

features: Made of Osier Willow, 100% Natural: The bread basket is made of osier willow which grows in the golden growth zone for willow of 36 ° N. It grows on the wet grassland along the mountain river. Sufficient light and water make the wicker very flexible to weave a sturdy serving basket.

Bread Serving Basket for the Family: Fill this handwoven basket with muffins, fresh baked breads, homemade scones and offer your loved ones daily enjoyment they deserve. It will be an eye-catching great decor for your dining or coffee tables. Awesome housewarming or hostess gift for anyone！

Cute Little Baskets: Measures 9.8" (D) x 2.3" (H). The mini bread basket holds the perfect amount of bread for one or two. Smaller footprint to save space. Also makes for a great fruit basket (good air flow for fruit), Easter basket, wedding basket, gift basket or a catch-all dish.

Safer and Healthier: Uncoated, no chemical, this natural wicker basket is safer and healthier for storing food. Serve your food without worrying about the harmful substances that the plastic or poly wicker basket may decompose in case of heat or the chemical coating on the metal basket.

Each Workmanship Basket is Unique: The wicker fruit bowl is woven by artisans who know their craft. This is an intangible cultural heritage that has been passed on for more than 200 years. Every NUTRIUPS basket is unique, they’re not machine made replicas.
